description:
NeNe Folio is a simple Markdown note app for Windows.
Organize daily notes, reading logs and ideas in progress into categories. Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts and more written in Mermaid appear as diagrams right inside your notes.

■ Write and read back
Edit the Markdown source, and read headings, lists, tables, quotes, definition lists, footnotes and code blocks neatly laid out in Read mode. Code in supported languages gets basic syntax colors, and a code block can be copied with one click. In a long note, a list of headings beside the body takes you to any heading with a click.

■ Draw diagrams with Mermaid
Write Mermaid syntax in a code block marked mermaid, and Read mode shows it as a flowchart, sequence diagram, state diagram, ER diagram, class diagram, pie chart or Gantt chart. Diagrams follow the colors of the current theme, and the note text appears first while diagrams finish one by one. No script runs and nothing is fetched to draw a diagram. Your note keeps the Mermaid source as written.

■ Add images
Show PNG and JPEG images from local files or HTTPS links. An HTTPS image needs a connection to the server that hosts it.

■ Find the note you need
Star notes as favorites and tag them, then filter by both. The note finder combines fuzzy name search with body search and lets you check each match before you open it. You can also search inside the open note and use regular-expression replace while editing.

■ Organize, with save history
Color your categories, reorder notes by dragging, and move a note to another category from its right-click menu. Up to five earlier versions are kept when you save, and you can restore one into the editor.

■ Import and export
Import UTF-8 Markdown files and export the current note as Markdown. A ZIP export of saved notes can include the local images they reference. The ZIP does not include settings or save history; back up the whole notes folder to keep those too.

■ Your look, your way
Choose from many themes, including light and dark, with a live preview. Zoom, a minimap, line numbers while editing, a right-click menu in the note body, keyboard shortcuts and a command list are built in, and the window opens where you last left it.

Notes are saved as Markdown files in a folder you choose. No account, no ads, and no usage data is sent. The interface is available in English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

Requirements: Windows 10 version 2004 or later, x64.
HTML rendering and built-in cloud sync are not supported. Images are limited to PNG and JPEG. Mermaid supports the main syntax of the diagram types listed above; other diagram types and diagram styling are not supported. Gantt charts never use today's date, so they are drawn from tasks with a written start date.
features: Read and edit Markdown: headings, lists, tables, quotes, definition lists, footnotes and basic code colors
Mermaid flowcharts, sequence, state, ER and class diagrams, pie and Gantt charts in your theme's colors
Jump to any heading from a headings list beside the note, by mouse or keyboard
Filter notes by favorites and tags, and find notes by name and body
Show PNG/JPEG images from local files or HTTPS links
Import and export Markdown; bundle saved notes and their images into a ZIP
Color-coded categories; reorder and move notes by drag or right-click
Search in the open note and replace with regular expressions while editing
Keep up to five earlier versions when saving and restore from history
Theme preview, zoom, minimap, line numbers and a right-click menu
Choose where notes are saved; English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese interface
shortDescription: A Markdown note app that brings together categories, favorites and tags, a headings list, images and Mermaid diagrams such as flowcharts, sequence diagrams and Gantt charts. Write in the theme you like and keep your daily notes in a folder you choose.
